structure_template.source_record: COD 9001868; Geiger and Armbruster, American Mineralogist 82 (1997), 740-747; 293 K; Ia-3d, space group 230
structure_template.source_license: COD public domain / CC0; retain attribution to the source article

forward_model.wavelength_basis: same-ID RRUFF Refinement_Data peak rows use wavelength #2; XY_RAW does not state wavelength
forward_model.wavelength_uncertainty: proxy only; the raw profile has no directly recorded instrument wavelength
forward_model.intensity_scale_and_constant_background: solved by bounded two-column linear least squares at each candidate a; not structural parameters
known_approximations: no K-alpha doublet, preferred orientation, absorption, microstrain, or phase mixture model

development_data_policy.refinement_output_cell_role: post-fit reference estimate only; never used for initialization, bounds, ranking, or fitting
development_data_policy.raw_spectra_commit_policy: do not commit or export source profile arrays

real_explanation_gate_predeclared.notes: Engineering stop/go criterion fixed before reading real-profile results; it is not a calibrated accuracy threshold or publication claim.
